description: Explore PostHog's Inbox — the surface where signal reports surface as actionable issues and trends. Use when the user asks "what's in my inbox?", "what should I look at?", "which reports are actionable?", "what's PostHog flagged recently?", asks about a specific report by ID or title, or wants to see which signal sources are configured. Covers listing, filtering, and drilling into reports, plus pointers to the deeper `signals` skill when raw signals or semantic search are needed.
